ValidationRule.description: Purchase Equipment Type field is required when Category Level 3 is Equipment Service
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(OR(RecordType.DeveloperName = 'NA_Quality',RecordType.DeveloperName = 'NA_Non_Quality'), $Profile.Name<>'CCNA Bottler', NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status,'New')), ISPICKVAL( Country_Code__c ,'US'), CONTAINS(TEXT( NA1_Category_Level_3__c ),'Equipment Service'), ISPICKVAL(Equipment_Type__c,'') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Purchase Equipment Type field is required when Category Level 3 is Equipment Service
